install:
set -euo pipefail
if [ ! -f scripts/setup.sh ]; then
  cd /agent/repos/audiobook-boss
fi
bash scripts/setup.sh
eval "$(scripts/setup.sh --print-env)"
# Later shells do not inherit install exports. Link the toolchain onto the default PATH instead of editing a profile.
ln -sfn "${BUN_INSTALL}/bin/bun" "${BUN_INSTALL}/bin/bunx"
tools="${HOME}/.local/share/audiobook-boss/bin"
link() {
  sudo ln -sfn "$1" "/usr/local/bin/$(basename "$1")"
}
link "${BUN_INSTALL}/bin/bun"
link "${BUN_INSTALL}/bin/bunx"
link "${DOTNET_ROOT}/dotnet"
for name in cargo-audit cargo-deny ffmpeg ffprobe uv uvx actionlint; do
  link "${tools}/${name}"
done
cargo build --locked -p abb-engine --features bundled-ffmpeg
find target/abb-ffmpeg-cache -path '*/dist/lib/libavutil.a' -print -quit | grep -q .
